policy_presence.summary: Current Academic Misconduct Policy plus detailed King's AI guidance.

coursework.summary: Four-level framework applied per assessment brief; no ban; copying AI output not appropriate.

exams.summary: No general exam permission found; set per assessment.

ai_disclosure.summary: Coursework declaration statement required; RD2 declaration for doctoral theses.

privacy_data_entry.summary: No personal/sensitive/others' content; doctoral uploads need supervisory approval; staff need permission to upload student work.

academic_integrity.summary: Staged process (AIM, contestation, Committee, appeal); poor practice distinct from misconduct.

approved_tools.summary: Copilot available to all via KCL account; not an assessment permission.

named_ai_services.summary: Microsoft Copilot with commercial data protection.

teaching_guidance.summary: Considered use, Russell Group principles, AI-assisted marking guidance.

research_guidance.summary: Doctoral assistive use allowed with conditions and approvals.

security_procurement.summary: Staff should use institutionally approved GDPR-compliant tools for marking; no general procurement rule reviewed.
